hook: Last five United-Liverpool — and somehow United have won three of them.
narration: Last five United-Liverpool — and somehow United have won three of them. Number five. April 2024, Old Trafford, Premier League. Two-two. Bruno from the halfway line, Mainoo's rocket at eighteen, Salah's late penalty. A draw that flattered nobody. Number four. September 2024, Old Trafford. Three-nil Liverpool. Diaz brace, Salah added the third. Slot won his first United meeting; ten Hag was sacked weeks later. Number three. January 2025, Anfield. Two-two. Martinez's rocket, Salah's penalty, Amad's eighty-minute equaliser. Premier League leaders held. Amorim's first big point at United. Number two. October 2025, Anfield. United two, Liverpool one. Mbeumo inside two minutes. Gakpo equalised. Then Maguire — yes, Maguire — headed United's first Anfield win in nine years. Number one. May 2026, Old Trafford. Three-two. Cunha and Sesko inside fifteen. Liverpool clawed back through Szoboszlai and Gakpo. Then Mainoo, again — seventy-seventh-minute winner. First Premier League double over Liverpool in a decade. LIKE if you were there. COMMENT next rivalry to recap.
